Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 5, Verse 13

“Mentally renouncing all actions, the embodied one dwells at ease and in control in the city of nine gates — neither acting nor causing action.”

The body as a nine-gated city is a wonderfully architectural image. The self is resident rather than labourer, and the gates are the openings through which everything passes.
